create_conversation: create a conversation with participants and title using MessagingApp create_conversation method
send_message: send a text message to a conversation using MessagingApp send_message method
search_messages: search conversations by query string with optional date filters using MessagingApp search method
regex_search: search conversations using regex patterns across messages participants and titles with MessagingApp regex_search
send_attachment: send a file attachment to a conversation using MessagingApp send_attachment and download_attachment methods
